dialogue.origin: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise.

dialogue.origin: お時間前ですが始めさせて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？それともジャストの方がよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a little before our scheduled time. Is it alright if we start now, or would you prefer to wait until the exact time?

dialogue.origin: 始めてください
dialogue.content: Please start.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。では、宜しくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: ニックネームで構いませんので、お呼びしてよいお名前お伺い出来ますか？
dialogue.content: A nickname is fine. Could you please tell me what name you'd like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: 吉田です
dialogue.content: It's Yoshida.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 吉田さん、今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yoshida-san, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 仕事がつまらない
dialogue.content: My job is boring.

dialogue.origin: お仕事のお悩みですね差し支えなければどの様な業種かお伺いしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I see, it's about your work. If you don't mind my asking, what kind of industry are you in?

dialogue.origin: 業種はメーカーです
dialogue.content: I'm in manufacturing.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますメーカーさんになられたのは吉田さんのご希望だったのですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Was it your wish to work for a manufacturer, Yoshida-san?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お仕事がつまらなくなったとお感じになられたのはいつごろからでしょうか？
dialogue.content: About when did you start to feel that your job had become boring?

dialogue.origin: 今年の４月からです
dialogue.content: Since this April.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか4月にどのような事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. What happened in April?

dialogue.origin: 部長が変わりました
dialogue.content: The department head changed.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね部長さんとは、上司にあたる方なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is the department head your direct supervisor?

dialogue.origin: 私の上に課長がいます
dialogue.content: I have a section manager above me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかでは2つ上の上司になられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So he's your manager's manager.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 前の部長さんとの関係はどの様な感じだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What was your relationship like with the previous department head?

dialogue.origin: やりやすかった
dialogue.content: They were easy to work with.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかやり難い部長さんに代わってしまい毎日の事ですからお辛くなりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be difficult for you, having to deal with a difficult department head every day.

dialogue.origin: つまらない…
dialogue.content: It's boring...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねつまらない。とお感じになられるのは部長さんの言動からでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you feel it's boring because of the department head's words and actions?

dialogue.origin: まぁそうです
dialogue.content: Well, yes.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねどんな時に嫌な気持ちになられてしまいますか？
dialogue.content: I see. What kinds of things make you feel upset?

dialogue.origin: 細かい、口うるさい、信用してくれない…
dialogue.content: They're nitpicky, overbearing, and don't trust me…

dialogue.origin: ええ！そうなのですか3拍子そろって嫌な態度でしたらかなりお困りですよね
dialogue.content: Oh my! Really? If it's the full trifecta of unpleasant behaviors, that must be quite difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 面倒くさいです
dialogue.content: He's a pain to deal with.

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうね・・・因みに前の部長さんの良かった所をお聞きしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I imagine so... By the way, could you tell me what was good about the previous department head?

dialogue.origin: 任せてくれる、信頼してくれる、最後責任とってくれる…
dialogue.content: He let me handle things, trusted me, and would take responsibility in the end...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか良き部長さんだったのですねそれに比べ、今の部長さんは３拍子嫌な所がそろってらしゃる・・・
dialogue.content: I see—so they were a good department head. In comparison, the current one has the trifecta of unpleasant traits...

dialogue.origin: 吉田さんは、
dialogue.content: Yoshida-san,

dialogue.origin: 会社にお勤めになって何年目になられるのですか？
dialogue.content: how many years have you been with the company?

dialogue.origin: こういうの三拍子っていうんですかぁ
dialogue.content: Is that what you call a 'trifecta'?

dialogue.origin: ７年目です
dialogue.content: This is my seventh year.

dialogue.origin: 不適切な表現でしたらごめんなさいでは、もう充分お仕事も信頼され任せてもらっていい状態ですよね
dialogue.content: I apologize if my choice of words was inappropriate. At seven years, you're at a point where you should be trusted and given responsibility, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: 前はそうでしたが。あ
dialogue.content: It used to be that way. Ah—

dialogue.origin: つい最近は、ミスの責任押し付けられました…
dialogue.content: It used to be that way, but just recently, I was blamed for a mistake...

dialogue.origin: ミスの押し付け・・そんなことがおありになったのですね腹立たしいことですね！
dialogue.content: Being blamed for a mistake... so that's what happened. That's infuriating!

dialogue.origin: やめたくなりました
dialogue.content: It made me want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 自分のミスを部下に押し付けるよな上司でしたら、それは辞めたくなってとうぜんですよね
dialogue.content: If a boss pushes their own mistake onto a subordinate, it's only natural you'd want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 辞めるのが当然なんですね…
dialogue.content: So quitting is the natural thing to do...?

dialogue.origin: 辞めるのが当然ではなく、辞めたくなる気持ちになっても当然の事と思いました
dialogue.content: Not that quitting itself is the natural course of action, but I meant that it's completely natural to feel like you want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 踏みとどまった自分がアホなのかと思いました
dialogue.content: I thought I was a fool for not quitting.

dialogue.origin: よく、踏ん張って今日までこられたととてもお強さを感じてます
dialogue.content: I think it shows great strength that you've held on and made it this far.

dialogue.origin: 疲れてます
dialogue.content: I'm tired.

dialogue.origin: 細かい、口うるさい、信用してくれないおまけに、自分のミスまで押し付けられたらたまったものではありませんよね
dialogue.content: Nitpicky, nagging, untrusting... and on top of that, he blames you for his own mistakes. That's just unbearable, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その部長さんは、吉田さんだけにそのような態度なのですか？皆さんにもなのですか？
dialogue.content: Does this department head act that way only towards you, Yoshida-san? Or is it with everyone?

dialogue.origin: みんなです
dialogue.content: Towards everyone.

dialogue.origin: 皆さんにもですか・・・吉田さんの直の課長さんとは何かお話になられましたか？
dialogue.content: With everyone, I see... Have you talked with your direct section manager about any of this?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 課長は最大の被害者
dialogue.content: The section manager is the biggest victim.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね課長さんは吉田さんよりお辛い思いをなさってたのですねどんなお話をなされたかお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So your manager is having an even harder time than you are. May I ask what you talked about?

dialogue.origin: 細かい、うるさい、信用してくれない
dialogue.content: He's nitpicky, nags, and doesn't trust us.

dialogue.origin: 責任取らずに押し付けられました
dialogue.content: He pushed the blame on me without taking responsibility.

dialogue.origin: 課長さんが最大の被害者。という事は吉田さんのお怒りは全部吐き出すのを抑えてしまうことはおありですか？
dialogue.content: If the section manager is the greatest victim, do you sometimes hold back from venting all of your anger?

dialogue.origin: 全部吐き出してすべて課長は理解してくれますが…
dialogue.content: I vent about everything, and my manager understands it all, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: では課長さんには、全て打ち明けられたのですね
dialogue.content: So you've confided everything to the section manager.

dialogue.origin: はい、なんか私の言い方が悪いのか、上手く伝わってないみたいで…
dialogue.content: Yes, but... I'm not sure if it's the way I'm saying it, but it seems like I'm not getting my point across well...

dialogue.origin: それは、私への事ですか？
dialogue.content: Are you referring to me?

dialogue.origin: 課長さんへの事ですか？
dialogue.content: Or to your manager?

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんに伝わってない
dialogue.content: It's not getting through to you, counselor.

dialogue.origin: 私の質問の仕方がよくなかったですね不快な思いをさせてしまい申し訳ないです
dialogue.content: My way of questioning must have been poor. I'm very sorry for making you feel uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: ミスを押し付けられたお話をもう少しお聞かせいただいてよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Could you please tell me a little more about the time you were blamed for the mistake?

dialogue.origin: はい、是非聴いてください
dialogue.content: Yes, please do listen.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますどんな事があったのか教えてください
dialogue.content: Thank you. Please tell me what happened.

dialogue.origin: はい、やっと聞いてくれましたね。
dialogue.content: Yes, you're finally asking.

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ないです・・・タイミング遅かったですね
dialogue.content: I'm sorry... My timing was off.

dialogue.origin: 是非お聞かせ願います！
dialogue.content: Please, tell me all about it!

dialogue.origin: 毎月100kgコンスタントの顧客から、先月だけ1000kg注文が来て、明らかに顧客のミスだと私が部長と課長に報告したら、部長はそのままの数量量で出せ、顧客に確認しなくて良い、と部長が私に指示してきた…　製造・物流大混乱。他の顧客の数量調整。しかし出荷直前で顧客から数量ミスの連絡…その時部長は、吉田が悪いと全体会議で発言した…
dialogue.content: A customer who consistently orders 100kg every month placed an order for 1000kg last month. I reported to the department head and my manager that it was clearly the customer's mistake, but the department head instructed me to ship the full amount and that there was no need to confirm with the customer... It caused chaos in production and logistics. We had to adjust quantities for other customers. But just before shipping, the customer contacted us about the quantity mistake... At that point, the department head announced in a general meeting that it was my fault...

dialogue.origin: コロナで売上激減しているので部長は無理やり成果を出そうとした
dialogue.content: Sales have dropped drastically due to COVID, so the department head was trying to force results.

dialogue.origin: 製造も物流も営業課長も、みんな、吉田は悪くないと言ってくれた…
dialogue.content: Production, logistics, the sales manager... everyone told me it wasn't my fault...

dialogue.origin: それ以来、新部長には不信感…
dialogue.content: Ever since then, I haven't trusted the new department head...

dialogue.origin: 100Ｋを1000Ｋと間違え確認もせずに！皆が奮闘してる中で、最後には部長は吉田さんのせいになさった訳ですね！それは酷過ぎる！
dialogue.content: A 1000kg order instead of 100kg, and without even confirming! While everyone was scrambling to deal with it, in the end, the department head blamed you, Yoshida-san! That's just awful!

dialogue.origin: よく知らない部長を押さえられなかった私にも責任あります
dialogue.content: I also feel responsible for not being able to stop a department head I didn't know well.

dialogue.origin: そんな酷い事がおありになられた訳ですねでも周りの皆さんは吉田さんをよく理解してくださったのが不幸中のさいわいでしたね部長を押さえられない事に責任を感じる必要は全くないと私は思いますよ
dialogue.content: So that's the terrible thing that happened. But it was a blessing in disguise that everyone around you understood the situation. I don't think you need to feel any responsibility for not being able to stop the department head.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そこで、私が責任かぶったので、みんなから、株上がったなと言われたのが、踏みとどまった理由です。新部長になって、コロナです業績悪くなって、なんか、持ってない人だなぁと、気の毒に思います
dialogue.content: Well, the reason I didn't quit is because I took the fall, and everyone told me my stock went up with them. With the new department head, performance has worsened due to COVID... I almost feel sorry for him, like he's just an unlucky person.

dialogue.origin: でも部長との仕事は面白くない
dialogue.content: But working with the department head is not enjoyable.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか皆さんも部長の悪行は充分把握しているのでしょうから吉田さんは救われて本当に良かったですそんな思いの中でも、部長に憐れみをお感じにもなれれるのですね芯の強さに感激します
dialogue.content: I see. I'm truly glad you had that support, since everyone else must be fully aware of the department head's misconduct. Even after all that, you can feel a sense of pity for him. I'm impressed by your inner strength.

dialogue.origin: かといって、部長がいなくなってくれる訳ではないのがシンドイ感じですよね
dialogue.content: That said, it must be draining that the department head isn't just going to disappear, right?

dialogue.origin: そんなに強くないですが、いい仲間に支えられてます
dialogue.content: I'm not that strong, but I'm supported by good colleagues.

dialogue.origin: サラリーマンは上司を選べないです
dialogue.content: As a salaried employee, you can't choose your boss.

dialogue.origin: そうですね本当に良きお仲間ですねそれは吉田さんのお人柄でもあるのではないでしょうか。サラリーマンのお辛い所はそこですよね・・
dialogue.content: That's true. They sound like truly good colleagues. I imagine that's a reflection of your own character, Yoshida-san. And yes, that is one of the hard parts of being a salaried employee...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 皆さんが部長には不満を持ちながらも、協力し合い乗り越えていってる感じなのでしょうが、吉田さんは辛すぎる感じがつまらない。となってしまうのでしょうかね
dialogue.content: It sounds like everyone, while dissatisfied with the department head, is cooperating to get through it. But for you, the difficulty of it all manifests as feeling like it's 'boring,' perhaps?

dialogue.origin: まぁなんとかやります。言いたかったことが第三者の相談員さんに言えて、相談員さんに気持ちを受け止めていただき、なんかスッキリしました。誰かにきいてほしかったので。
dialogue.content: Well, I'll manage somehow. I feel relieved now that I've been able to say what I wanted to say to a third-party counselor like you, and you've understood my feelings. I just wanted someone to listen.

dialogue.origin: そうですかそれなら良かったです！大事なお話を聞くタイミングが悪くて申し訳なかったです
dialogue.content: I see, I'm glad to hear that! I'm sorry that my timing was off when it came to listening to your important story.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: 上手く聞き事が出来ず申し訳なさも感じてはいますが、吉田さんがスッキリなされてこれからも良きお仲間と頑張っていけるのであればなによりです
dialogue.content: I feel bad that I wasn't able to listen as well as I should have, but I'm truly happy if you're feeling relieved and can continue to do your best with your good colleagues.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話をお聞かせ下さりありがとうございました又、何かありましたらいつでもお越しになられてください
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your story with me today. If anything else comes up, please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 吉田さんの今後のお活躍、心より応援しております！無理せず良き仲間と頑張ってくださいね
dialogue.content: I'll be rooting for your success from the bottom of my heart, Yoshida-san! Don't push yourself too hard, and keep up the good work with your colleagues.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: No, thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: (時間オーバーしてしまい申し訳なかったです。最後までお付き合いくださりありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry we went over time. Thank you for staying with me until the end.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: (又、お会い出来たらその時はよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (If we have the chance to speak again, I look forward to it.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: (では、これで終了ボタンを押させていただきますね)
dialogue.content: (Okay, I will press the end button now.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

topic.sub: 新しい部長とのコミュニケーションの問題
